_comment: Error pattern library (services/diagnostics). Order matters: the first pattern whose regex matches wins.
match: regexes (case-insensitive, one log line each); named groups become params usable as {name} in the texts.
exit_codes: used only when no regex of any pattern matched. sources: limit a pattern to callers that pass one of them.
Texts with {placeholders} need a 'generic' variant, used when a placeholder was not captured.
i18n keys: diag_<id>_cause and diag_<id>_step<n> (no dots). Every pattern has a real log sample in tests/samples/logs/<id>*.log.

match: couldn't bind HTTP server socket, hostname: \S+, port: (?P<port>\d+)
error while attempting to bind on address \('[^']*', (?P<port>\d+)\)
Bind for \S*:(?P<port>\d+) failed: port is already allocated
listen tcp\d? \S*:(?P<port>\d+): bind: address already in use
only one usage of each socket address

cause.text: Port {port} is already in use by another program
cause.generic: The port is already in use by another program

steps.text: Find and stop the program that holds port {port} (often a llama-server or vLLM started by hand, or an old service). Linux: ss -ltnp | grep :{port}; Windows: netstat -ano | findstr :{port}
steps.generic: Find and stop the program that holds the port (often a llama-server or vLLM started by hand, or an old service). Linux: ss -ltnp; Windows: netstat -ano

steps: Or move SlotServe's ports away from it: SLOTSERVE_LLAMA_PORT for the model servers (each lane uses the next port), the SSH and direct port ranges for dev environments; then restart SlotServe
Retry the load once the port is free

cause.text: 端口 {port} 已被其他程序占用
cause.generic: 端口已被其他程序占用

steps.text: 找到并停掉占用端口 {port} 的程序（常见：手动启动的 llama-server / vLLM，或旧的服务）。Linux：ss -ltnp | grep :{port}；Windows：netstat -ano | findstr :{port}
steps.generic: 找到并停掉占用该端口的程序（常见：手动启动的 llama-server / vLLM，或旧的服务）。Linux：ss -ltnp；Windows：netstat -ano

steps: 或把 SlotServe 的端口挪开：模型服务用 SLOTSERVE_LLAMA_PORT（每个通道依次使用后面的端口），开发环境用 SSH 与直连端口范围；改完重启 SlotServe
端口空出后重试加载

match: There is not enough space on the disk

steps: Free space on the disk named in the log: the models folder, the data directory or Docker's data root (docker system df; docker image prune)
Remove models or saved environment images that are no longer needed
Retry once there is enough room
清理日志中提到的磁盘：模型目录、数据目录或 Docker 数据目录（docker system df；docker image prune）
删除不再需要的模型或已保存的环境镜像
空间足够后重试

match: max seq len \((?P<max_len>\d+)\) is larger than the maximum number of tokens that can be stored in KV cache
max seq len \((?P<max_len>\d+)\), \([\d.]+ GiB KV cache is needed

cause.text: The context length ({max_len} tokens) does not fit into the GPU memory left for the KV cache
cause.generic: The context length does not fit into the GPU memory left for the KV cache

steps: Or raise --gpu-memory-utilization (up to about 0.95) when nothing else uses the GPU
Or use more GPUs (--tensor-parallel-size) or a smaller / more quantized model

cause.text: 上下文长度（{max_len} tokens）放不进剩余给 KV 缓存的显存
cause.generic: 上下文长度放不进剩余给 KV 缓存的显存

steps.text: 调小 --max-model-len（这块 GPU 约能放下 {fit_len}）

steps: 或在 GPU 无其他占用时调大 --gpu-memory-utilization（最高约 0.95）
或使用更多 GPU（--tensor-parallel-size）、更小或量化程度更高的模型

match: allocating (?P<size>[\d.]+ [MG]iB) on device (?P<device>\d+): cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
Tried to allocate (?P<size>[\d.]+ [MG]iB)\. GPU (?P<device>\d+) has a total capacity
failed to allocate buffer for kv cache
No available memory for the cache blocks

cause.text: GPU {device} ran out of memory while loading the model
cause.generic: The GPU ran out of memory while loading the model

steps: Lower the context size (llama.cpp -c, vLLM --max-model-len): the KV cache grows with it
Offload fewer layers to the GPU (llama.cpp -ngl) or use a smaller quantization of the model
Check that nothing else uses the GPU (nvidia-smi): another model, a dev environment or a job

cause.text: 加载模型时 GPU {device} 显存不足
cause.generic: 加载模型时 GPU 显存不足

steps: 调小上下文长度（llama.cpp 的 -c，vLLM 的 --max-model-len）：KV 缓存随之增长
少放几层到 GPU（llama.cpp 的 -ngl），或换用量化程度更高的模型
确认没有其他程序占用 GPU（nvidia-smi）：另一个模型、开发环境或任务

en.cause: The process was stopped because the machine ran out of RAM
steps: Check free memory (free -h) and what else is running; dev environments and other models use RAM too
Use a smaller model or quantization; with llama.cpp put more layers on the GPU (-ngl) and do not use --no-mmap
For dev environments: set a memory limit so one container cannot take everything

zh-CN.cause: 机器内存（RAM）不足，进程被系统终止
steps: 查看可用内存（free -h）和其他正在运行的程序；开发环境和其他模型也占用内存
换用更小的模型或量化版本；llama.cpp 用 -ngl 放更多层到 GPU，且不要加 --no-mmap
开发环境：设置内存上限，避免一个容器占满全部内存

match: could not select device driver "(?P<driver>[^"]*)" with capabilities
unknown or invalid runtime name: nvidia

en.cause: Docker cannot give the container a GPU: the NVIDIA Container Toolkit is missing or not set up
steps: Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the Docker host, run sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker and restart Docker
Check that the host driver works (nvidia-smi) and test: docker run --rm --gpus all ubuntu nvidia-smi
Docker Desktop on Windows: use the WSL 2 backend with a current NVIDIA driver

zh-CN.cause: Docker 无法为容器分配 GPU：未安装或未配置 NVIDIA Container Toolkit
steps: 在 Docker 主机上安装 NVIDIA Container Toolkit，执行 sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime=docker 并重启 Docker
确认宿主机驱动正常（nvidia-smi），并测试：docker run --rm --gpus all ubuntu nvidia-smi
Windows 上的 Docker Desktop：使用 WSL 2 后端并安装较新的 NVIDIA 驱动

match: CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime version
The NVIDIA driver on your system is too old
forward compatibility was attempted on non supported HW
no kernel image is available for execution on the device

cause.text: The engine was built for CUDA {cuda}, which the GPU driver or the GPU does not support
cause.generic: The engine's CUDA version does not match the GPU driver or the GPU

steps: Update the NVIDIA driver on the host, or use an engine build for an older CUDA version
With Docker: the CUDA major version of CUDA_IMAGE must match the one llama-server was built with
A very new or very old GPU needs a build that includes its architecture (CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)

cause.text: 引擎按 CUDA {cuda} 构建，GPU 驱动或 GPU 不支持
cause.generic: 引擎的 CUDA 版本与 GPU 驱动或 GPU 不匹配

steps: 升级宿主机 NVIDIA 驱动，或改用针对较低 CUDA 版本构建的引擎
使用 Docker 时：CUDA_IMAGE 的 CUDA 主版本必须与构建 llama-server 时一致
很新或很老的 GPU 需要包含其架构的构建（CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES）

match: error while loading shared libraries: (?P<library>\S+): cannot open shared object file
ImportError: (?P<library>lib\S+\.so[\d.]*): cannot open shared object file

cause.text: The engine cannot start: the library {library} is missing
cause.generic: The engine cannot start: a library it needs (a DLL or .so) is missing

steps: Usually the CUDA runtime does not match the engine build: install the matching CUDA runtime or use an engine build for the installed CUDA
Windows: put the cudart DLLs from the llama.cpp release next to llama-server.exe
Linux: ldd $(which llama-server) shows which libraries are missing

cause.text: 引擎无法启动：缺少库 {library}
cause.generic: 引擎无法启动：缺少所需的库（DLL 或 .so）

steps: 通常是 CUDA 运行库与引擎构建不匹配：安装对应的 CUDA 运行库，或换用与已安装 CUDA 对应的引擎构建
Windows：把 llama.cpp 发布包里的 cudart DLL 放到 llama-server.exe 同一目录
Linux：ldd $(which llama-server) 可以看到缺少哪些库

cause.text: The engine program {path} cannot be run (not executable or built for another system)
cause.generic: The engine program cannot be run (not executable or built for another system)

steps.generic: Make it executable: chmod +x <path to llama-server>

steps: Check that the build matches this machine (x86_64 or arm64, Linux or Windows)
A folder mounted with noexec cannot run programs: move the engine or remount without noexec

cause.text: 引擎程序 {path} 无法运行（没有执行权限或为其他系统构建）
cause.generic: 引擎程序无法运行（没有执行权限或为其他系统构建）

steps.generic: 加上执行权限：chmod +x <llama-server 路径>

steps: 确认构建与本机匹配（x86_64 或 arm64，Linux 或 Windows）
以 noexec 挂载的目录不能运行程序：把引擎移到别处，或去掉 noexec 重新挂载

match: spawn failed: \[Errno 2\] No such file or directory: '(?P<path>[^']+)'
exec: "(?P<path>[^"]+)": executable file not found in \$PATH
'(?P<path>[^']+)' is not recognized as an internal or external command

cause.text: The engine program {path} was not found
cause.generic: The engine program was not found

steps: Set the full path of the engine: SLOTSERVE_LLAMA_SERVER_CMD for llama.cpp, SLOTSERVE_VLLM_CMD for vLLM; then restart SlotServe
With Docker: use the image variant that contains the engine (the vLLM image for vLLM models)
Check that the model uses the engine you installed (Models → engine)

cause.text: 找不到引擎程序 {path}
cause.generic: 找不到引擎程序

steps: 设置引擎的完整路径：llama.cpp 用 SLOTSERVE_LLAMA_SERVER_CMD，vLLM 用 SLOTSERVE_VLLM_CMD；改完重启 SlotServe
使用 Docker 时：选择包含该引擎的镜像（vLLM 模型需要 vLLM 镜像）
确认模型使用的是已安装的引擎（模型 → 引擎）

match: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at (?P<endpoint>[^\s?]+?)\.? Is the docker daemon running
permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at (?P<endpoint>[^\s:]+:[^\s:]+)

cause.text: SlotServe cannot reach Docker at {endpoint}
cause.generic: SlotServe cannot reach Docker

steps: Check that Docker is running on the host (docker info)
In Docker: mount the socket into SlotServe (-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock); outside Docker: the user running SlotServe needs access to it (docker group)
Check SLOTSERVE_DOCKER_HOST if Docker listens elsewhere (e.g. Podman's socket or tcp://)

cause.text: SlotServe 无法连接 Docker（{endpoint}）
cause.generic: SlotServe 无法连接 Docker

steps: 确认宿主机上 Docker 正在运行（docker info）
Docker 部署时把 socket 挂进 SlotServe（-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock）；非 Docker 部署时运行 SlotServe 的用户需要有权限访问它（docker 组）
如果 Docker 监听在别处（例如 Podman 的 socket 或 tcp://），检查 SLOTSERVE_DOCKER_HOST

cause.text: The image {image} could not be downloaded
cause.generic: The Docker image could not be downloaded

steps: Check the image name and tag (typos, a tag that does not exist)
Check that the Docker host can reach the registry (proxy, firewall, a registry mirror in /etc/docker/daemon.json)
Private images or Docker Hub's rate limit: docker login on the host, or pull the image once by hand (docker pull)

cause.text: 镜像 {image} 拉取失败
cause.generic: Docker 镜像拉取失败

steps: 检查镜像名称和 tag（拼写错误、tag 不存在）
确认 Docker 主机能访问镜像仓库（代理、防火墙，或在 /etc/docker/daemon.json 配置镜像加速）
私有镜像或触发 Docker Hub 拉取限额：在宿主机 docker login，或先手动 docker pull 一次

match: you might need a /sbin/mount\.(?:<type>|(?P<fstype>\w+)) helper program
failed to mount local volume: .*: no such device
wrong fs type, bad option, bad superblock on (?P<share>\S+?),
cifs filesystem not supported by the system

en.cause: The Docker host cannot mount this NFS/SMB share: the mount helper is missing
steps: Install the helper on the Docker host (not in the container): nfs-common (Debian/Ubuntu) or nfs-utils (RHEL) for NFS, cifs-utils for SMB
Then click Check on the storage again
Docker Desktop: the mount happens in its VM; use a host directory storage instead

zh-CN.cause: Docker 主机无法挂载该 NFS/SMB 共享：缺少挂载工具
steps: 在 Docker 主机上（不是容器里）安装挂载工具：NFS 用 nfs-common（Debian/Ubuntu）或 nfs-utils（RHEL），SMB 用 cifs-utils
然后在存储上重新点击「检查」
Docker Desktop：挂载发生在其虚拟机内，请改用宿主机目录类型的存储

match: mount\.nfs4?: access denied by server while mounting (?P<share>\S+)
failed to mount local volume: mount (?P<share>\S*?):/var/lib/docker\S*, .*(?:permission denied|access denied|operation not permitted)
failed to mount local volume: .*(?:permission denied|access denied|operation not permitted)

cause.text: The storage server refused the mount of {share}
cause.generic: The storage server refused the mount (wrong credentials or not allowed)

steps: SMB: check user name, password and domain in the storage settings
NFS: check that the export allows this Docker host's IP address (/etc/exports on the server, then exportfs -ra)
Then click Check on the storage again

cause.text: 存储服务器拒绝挂载 {share}
cause.generic: 存储服务器拒绝挂载（凭据错误或未授权）

steps: SMB：检查存储设置中的用户名、密码和域
NFS：确认导出允许本 Docker 主机的 IP（服务器上的 /etc/exports，然后 exportfs -ra）
然后在存储上重新点击「检查」

match: mount\.nfs4?: (?:Connection timed out|Connection refused|No route to host|Network is unreachable)
failed to mount local volume: mount (?P<share>\S*?):/var/lib/docker

cause.text: The share {share} could not be mounted: the server is not reachable or the share does not exist
cause.generic: The NFS/SMB share could not be mounted: the server is not reachable or the share does not exist

steps: Check the server address and the share path in the storage settings
Check that the Docker host reaches the server (ping; NFS port 2049, SMB port 445 open)
Then click Check on the storage again

cause.text: 共享 {share} 挂载失败：服务器不可达或共享不存在
cause.generic: NFS/SMB 共享挂载失败：服务器不可达或共享不存在

steps: 检查存储设置中的服务器地址和共享路径
确认 Docker 主机能访问服务器（ping；NFS 端口 2049、SMB 端口 445 已放行）
然后在存储上重新点击「检查」

match: Cannot access gated repo for url https://huggingface\.co/(?P<repo>[^/\s]+/[^/\s]+)
401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://huggingface\.co/

cause.text: Hugging Face refused access to {repo}
cause.generic: Hugging Face refused access to the model

steps: Gated models: accept the license on the model's Hugging Face page with your account
Set a Hugging Face access token (SLOTSERVE_HF_TOKEN, read permission) and retry
Check the repository name (private or renamed repositories also answer 401/404)

cause.text: Hugging Face 拒绝访问 {repo}
cause.generic: Hugging Face 拒绝访问该模型

steps: 受限模型：先用你的账号在该模型的 Hugging Face 页面同意许可
设置 Hugging Face 访问令牌（SLOTSERVE_HF_TOKEN，读权限）后重试
检查仓库名称（私有或改名的仓库同样返回 401/404）

match: failed to open GGUF file '(?P<path>[^']+)' \(Permission denied\)

cause.text: No permission to read {path}
cause.generic: No permission to read the model files

steps: Give the user that runs SlotServe and the engine read access to the models folder: chmod -R a+rX <models folder>
In Docker the container user must be able to read it; on NFS/SMB check the uid/gid mapping and mount options (uid=, file_mode=)
SELinux hosts: mount the folder with :z, or check the audit log

cause.text: 没有读取 {path} 的权限
cause.generic: 没有读取模型文件的权限

steps: 给运行 SlotServe 和引擎的用户模型目录的读权限：chmod -R a+rX <模型目录>
Docker 中需容器用户可读；NFS/SMB 上检查 uid/gid 映射与挂载选项（uid=、file_mode=）
启用 SELinux 的主机：挂载目录时加 :z，或查看审计日志

match: tensor '[^']+' data is not within the file bounds
incomplete metadata, file not fully covered

en.cause: The model file is damaged or incomplete
steps: Download the model again: an interrupted download is the usual cause (compare size or SHA-256 with the source)
Split models (…-00001-of-00003.gguf): all parts must be there; load the first part
Check that the file really is a GGUF model for llama.cpp (not a safetensors file renamed)

zh-CN.cause: 模型文件已损坏或不完整
steps: 重新下载模型：常见原因是下载中断（与来源比对大小或 SHA-256）
分卷模型（…-00001-of-00003.gguf）：所有分卷都要在，加载第一卷
确认文件确实是 llama.cpp 用的 GGUF 模型（不是改了扩展名的 safetensors）

cause.text: This engine version does not support the model ({arch})
cause.generic: This engine version does not support the model's format or architecture

steps: Update the engine: new model architectures need a recent llama.cpp release or vLLM version
Or use another build of the model (another quantization, or the GGUF from a different publisher)
llama.cpp loads GGUF files; vLLM loads Hugging Face model folders (safetensors)

cause.text: 当前引擎版本不支持该模型（{arch}）
cause.generic: 当前引擎版本不支持该模型的格式或架构

steps: 升级引擎：新的模型架构需要较新的 llama.cpp 或 vLLM 版本
或换一个版本的模型（其他量化，或其他发布者的 GGUF）
llama.cpp 加载 GGUF 文件；vLLM 加载 Hugging Face 模型目录（safetensors）

match: (?P<path>\S+) does not appear to have a file named (?P<file>[\w.-]+)
error loading model: llama_model_loader: failed to load model from (?P<path>\S+)

cause.text: The model {path} is missing or cannot be opened
cause.generic: The model file is missing or cannot be opened

steps: Check that the file still exists (it may have been moved, renamed or deleted) and scan the models folder again
Models on NFS/SMB: check that the share is mounted on this machine
vLLM: the folder must contain config.json and the weights

cause.text: 模型 {path} 不存在或无法打开
cause.generic: 模型文件不存在或无法打开

steps: 确认文件仍然存在（可能已被移动、改名或删除），并重新扫描模型目录
模型在 NFS/SMB 上时：确认共享已挂载到本机
vLLM：目录中需要有 config.json 和权重文件

match: model did not become ready within (?P<seconds>\d+)s

cause.text: The model did not finish loading within {seconds} seconds
cause.generic: The model did not finish loading in time

steps: Large models on slow disks or network storage take longer: raise SLOTSERVE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
Look at the end of the log: a server that hangs without progress usually has another error there
Copy the model to a local SSD for faster loading

cause.text: 模型在 {seconds} 秒内没有加载完成
cause.generic: 模型没有在规定时间内加载完成

steps: 大模型放在慢盘或网络存储上加载更慢：调大 SLOTSERVE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
查看日志末尾：没有进展的卡住通常另有错误
把模型复制到本地 SSD 以加快加载

match: The system cannot find the (?:file|path) specified

cause.text: A file or folder that is needed does not exist: {path}
cause.generic: A file or folder that is needed does not exist

steps: Check the path in the log: typos in launch arguments, moved model files or a folder that is not mounted
Paths inside Docker differ from the host: use the path as the container sees it
Retry after fixing the path

cause.text: 所需的文件或目录不存在：{path}
cause.generic: 所需的文件或目录不存在

steps: 检查日志中的路径：启动参数拼写错误、模型文件被移动，或目录未挂载
Docker 内的路径与宿主机不同：使用容器内看到的路径
修正路径后重试

cause.text: The process stopped with exit code {exit_code}; the cause was not recognized automatically
cause.generic: The cause was not recognized automatically

steps: Read the last log lines below: the error is usually near the end
Copy the diagnostic information and ask for help, or search the FAQ for the error text

cause.text: 进程以退出码 {exit_code} 结束，未能自动识别原因
cause.generic: 未能自动识别原因

steps: 查看下方日志的最后几行：错误通常在末尾
复制诊断信息求助，或在 FAQ 中搜索错误文本
